01 / The real problem

A prompt is not a control.

Writing do not delete anything into an instruction does not make deletion impossible. It is a request, and a system that works on probability is free to ignore it. No organization can run on the hope that the model behaves itself. What an AI is allowed to do has to be enforced outside the model, in a layer it cannot talk its way past.

02 / How we work

Fit the business. Make authority explicit.

AI that works with your business, inside limits you can point at.

  • 01

    Use the systems you already have

    You do not rebuild anything to suit us. We connect to the systems, data, identities and approvals your organization already runs on.

  • 02

    Nothing is permitted by default

    Every agent has a named identity, its own permissions and a defined scope. Claiming authority in a prompt does not create it.

  • 03

    People stay in charge

    Approved routine work runs on its own. Risk, doubt and anything unusual goes to the person who is accountable for it.

04 / Where human attention belongs

Decision-makers should look at what actually needs them.

AI takes the work that costs time and labour. People check the parts that matter. The system has to put complete, short evidence in front of the reviewer — not let AI run unchecked.

  • 01

    Normal result

    Continues inside the approved workflow.

  • 02

    High value, missing evidence or conflicting data

    Stops for a person to review.

  • 03

    Low confidence

    Escalates the doubt instead of inventing certainty.

  • 04

    Against policy

    Blocks the action and asks for review.

  • 05

    Wide blast radius

    Requires explicit approval before anything runs.
